scientific_question: Can actual marked adult entry through a Béchervaise Island gate, with time/direction and stable tag-ID, be joined within the SAME natal recipient island, individual and season to an independently recorded first nesting attempt and successful crèche?

sources.archival_status: PUBLIC_METADATA_AND_UNPROCESSED_OBSERVATIONS; ORIGINAL DATA FILE DOWNLOAD LINK NOT VERIFIED

sources.resights_noted_as: tag reader scanning at nests over Béchervaise Island; number of scanned nonbreeders NOT described as complete census

physical_geography.gate_risk_frame: one fenced group of breeding subcolonies on Béchervaise Island with marked/unmarked tags and direction/weight; DOES NOT sample every adult visiting entire island
physical_geography.historical_other_islands: Welch, Verner, Petersen/Peterson and Klung island hand-tag searches mentioned by obsolete indicator; their raw ID-year crosswalk not established in latest weighbridge-resight source
physical_geography.original_nest_geometry: 2002/03 colony K L Q physical nest layer exists DOI 10.4225/15/595350e32bffc, but nest number/tag color not proven same as penguin RFID individual
physical_geography.region: Mac. Robertson Land East Antarctica, DIFFERENT from Ross Island Cape Royds and Crozier

peer_review_vetoes: Emmerson & Southwell 2022 Global Change Biology 10.1111/gcb.16437 already reports 154000 breeding-bird drop associated with near-shore sea ice and inverse density-dependent fledgling survival/cohort size; do NOT relabel as new mechanistic discovery
Bechervaise automated radio tags 1990/91 as method and original data; first-nesting age and re-sights included in published models
Tracking all at-sea foraging paths is not required if fixed gate detects visitors, but tag presence near one subcolony is NOT independent all-colony arrival count
source_protocol: Download/inspect public publisher metadata and original official file URLs only. Never infer weighbridge raw data URL from a technical guide endpoint.
Official AADC HTTPS only; no insecure HTTP downgrades or substituted mirror. Reject JS app HTML, login forms or guessed file_ids as source data.
Never read original tag ID records until original technical guide confirms field coding, tag ID normalization, and deployment coverage.

Do not link tag numbers across distinct publications unless data custodian confirms code systems were stable and identical; tag reuse, quality codes, implausible timestamps and duplicated crossings must be QC'd.
Track at-risk admissions separately from transits, feeding returns and already established breeders; multiple crossings from one penguin are NOT multiple arrivals or independent individuals.
Breeding resight at a nest is a verified breeder only with independently measured egg or chick, not automatically every tag read.
Failure to resight an entrant on an observed nest is UNKNOWN / detection-limited, NOT confirmed no egg or death.
Original marked-colony gate covers specific subcolonies on ONE island; other islands need their own effort and ID-preserving visits before making an inter-island claim.
No additional field biological effect fits, no p-values, no changes to Ecology PR189, locked PR142 or emperor PR195.
estimand_if_joint_sources_confirmed: Among observed tagged individual gate entrants who were not established breeding earlier that season, proportion with own same-season independently confirmed first egg; adjust for missed gate scans and nest searches. Later additionally crèche success and origin.
